bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks are not allowed at El Corazon or The Funhouse. Water bottles and other plastic containers, thermoses, glass, cans, Sharpies, laser pointers and weapons are also prohibited. Coat and bag check is usually offered during all-ages shows.
prohibited: Animals other than certified guide dogs
bagPolicy.quote: bullhorns or noise makers, backpacks, Sharpies or markers, animals (except certified guide dogs).

parking.summary: Parking is available in front of the club and on surrounding streets. There are also two pay-to-park lots one block northwest, and you can reserve a spot through SpotHero.
parking.quote: Parking is available in front of the club and on surrounding streets.

rideshare.summary: El Corazon suggests Uber or Lyft for getting around Seattle, and there's a bus stop across the street. No pickup zone is published, so set your pickup to 109 Eastlake Ave E.
rideshare.quote: Download Uber or Lyft on your smartphone to get around Seattle with ease.

concessions.summary: The bars serve draft and bottled beer, spirits and non-alcoholic drinks. Outside food and drink are not allowed. The venue takes cash and all major credit cards, and there's an ATM inside.
concessions.quote: No outside food or drink is allowed into the Funhouse or El Corazon.

accessibility.summary: Wheelchair users and guests with special needs are welcome. Call 206-262-0482 or email info@elcorazonseattle.com ahead of time so staff can make arrangements. Certified guide dogs are allowed.
accessibility.quote: Of course! Please call ahead to 206-262-0482 or email info@elcorazonseattle.com so we can make arrangements.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is allowed if you're 21 or older. If you're under 21, you can't re-enter once you leave.
reEntry.quote: We do not allow re-entry for patrons under the age of 21. Re-entry is permitted for patrons over the age of 21.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is open Monday through Friday from 1 to 6pm. Call 206-262-0482 when you arrive, and note that phone orders aren't accepted. Each listing shows whether a show is 21+ or all ages, under-21s can't attend 21+ shows even with an adult, and your ID must show a photo, date of birth and expiration date.
ticketPickup.quote: Monday – Friday from 1-6pm. Call 206-262-0482 when you arrive.

gates.summary: Door times are listed for each show on the website, or you can call 206-262-0482. Arrive early, especially for sold-out shows, and wear shoes, since they're required to get in.
gates.quote: Shoes are required for access to the venue.
